DLC2314:4:t_100:1.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Charge! Just charge! Keep charging until we've smashed every enemy!」

DLC2314:4:t_100:2.en:
$$エイミー$$
「No! We can't let $$チェインバー#pilot$$ get hurt, so we have to be more careful!」

DLC2314:4:t_100:3.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Shut up! So you're fine with the fleet getting attacked?!」

DLC2314:4:t_100:5.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Then shut up and watch! I'll show you how to handle this machine!」

DLC2314:4:t_100:6.en:
$$エイミー$$
「I can't leave it to $$ピニオン$$! I'll fight together with $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

DLC2314:4:t_100:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Decision-making is estimated to require more time. Until then, this unit will set safety as its highest priority.」

DLC2314:4:t_101:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Now... Since my people will be in the fleet's care, I can't let the enemy lay a finger on the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

DLC2314:4:t_101:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「One day, under my command, this fleet will be reborn as the mightiest pirate armada!」

DLC2314:4:t_102:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「We rushed here on the commander's orders, and what the hell is this...?!」

DLC2314:4:t_102:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「For the fleet's sake, and $$レド$$'s, let's get rid of these enemies quickly!」

DLC2314:4:t_103:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
（That $$人類銀河同盟$$ soldier... He's become a full member of the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ now.）

DLC2314:4:t_103:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
（He's found a place to belong... And he's fighting desperately to protect it...）

DLC2314:4:t_104:1.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「He doesn't care even if the enemy is a machine...」

DLC2314:4:t_104:2.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「I've been wondering... Why haven't you been invited into the $$貧乏くじ同盟$$, $$ガムリン$$?」

DLC2314:4:t_104:4.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「$$バサラ$$ clams up about anything he's not interested in. You're an unlucky caretaker with a tight-lipped partner... You fit perfectly.」

DLC2314:4:t_104:5.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「No, he doesn't. With the captain, it's less that $$バサラ$$ drags him around, and more that he's $$バサラ$$'s partner in crime.」

DLC2314:4:t_104:6.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「That's true! Now that you mention it, you're right!」

DLC2314:4:t_104:7.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Haha... Haha... I suppose so...」

DLC2314:4:t_104:8.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「But I'm actually quite fond of the role I have now.」

DLC2314:4:t_104:10.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「You sing, too, $$ミレーヌ$$! I'll handle the fighting!」

review.context: Combat exchanges show Amy and Pinion arguing over Chamber, Lukkage's pirate ambitions, Brera envying Ledo's home and Gamlin choosing his supporting role.
decisions: The Macross speaker Ray is distinguished from Gundam Rey and Evangelion Rei.
The Hard Luck Alliance description identifies a personality pattern rather than an actual military organization.
